## Story DD Coverage
DD2 (partial — remaining cluster): bash blocks + EMIT-PRECONDITIONS landmarks at remaining 6 skill file fallthrough sites

## What
Read the frozen inventory (T2) to identify remaining cluster fallthrough sites. Add EMIT-PRECONDITIONS HTML comment landmarks + bash blocks at each site. Remove remaining cluster RED markers from .test-index.

## Target Files
- plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md
- plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md
- plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md
- plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md
- plugins/dso/skills/validate-work/SKILL.md
- plugins/dso/skills/shared/workflows/epic-scrutiny-pipeline.md

## Instrumentation Pattern (per T2 frozen format)
At each fallthrough site identified in the inventory:
1. Insert: <!-- EMIT-PRECONDITIONS: gate_name=<name> degradation_type=<type> -->
2. Insert bash block calling preconditions-record.sh with --degradation --degradation-type flags and 2>/dev/null || true

## .test-index Changes
REMOVE all 6 remaining RED markers (see T1 .test-index entries)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] EMIT-PRECONDITIONS landmark present in each of the 6 remaining skill files
  Verify: for f in plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md plugins/dso/skills/validate-work/SKILL.md plugins/dso/skills/shared/workflows/epic-scrutiny-pipeline.md; do grep -q 'EMIT-PRECONDITIONS' "$f" || { echo "Missing in $f"; exit 1; }; done
- [ ] Bash blocks use fail-open pattern (2>/dev/null || true)
  Verify: grep -A5 'EMIT-PRECONDITIONS' plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md | grep -q '|| true'
- [ ] All remaining RED markers removed from .test-index
  Verify: ! grep '\[test_remaining_cluster_landmarks\]' .test-index
- [ ] test_remaining_cluster_landmarks passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-preconditions-fallthrough-landmarks.sh test_remaining_cluster_landmarks
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user
